summary.text: AIRCONDITION PRODUKTER AS (993 895 628), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2009-01-30; address Setraveien 46, 1914 YTRE ENEBAKK, Norge. Main industry is Refrigeration installation, heat pump installation and installation of fireplaces (43.222); 1 registered sub-unit(s). Board chair: Henrik Lund Serrano. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 5.30 m, operating profit NOK 1.45 m, net profit NOK 1.17 m, equity NOK 4.89 m, total assets NOK 6.48 m.
